claims.claim_vi: The source lists five steps: clients send editing operations to the WebSocket server; it handles real-time communication; operations are persisted in a message queue; the file operation server consumes them and generates transformed operations with collaboration algorithms; three kinds of data are stored (file metadata, file content, operations).

claims.claim_vi: The source names real-time conflict resolution as the biggest challenge and lists OT, DS and CRDT; it says Google Docs uses OT according to its Wikipedia page and CRDT is an active research area.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Own experiment, 2026-10-19, Python 3, insert-only operational transformation: on base ABC, Alice inserts X at 1 and Bob inserts Y at 2 concurrently; applying the other's operation untransformed gives AXYBC and AXBYC (diverged), with transformation both give AXBYC; over 10,000 random concurrent insert pairs untransformed diverged 10,000 times and transformed 0 times.
